coverImageAlt: Nested navy acoustic chambers send orange and cyan ribbons into stone bowls at increasing distances.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Tiered communications represented by one clear core signal passing through three progressively wider handcrafted acoustic chambers, emerging as coordinated waves that reach near, middle, and distant listening vessels with appropriate detail, conveying one message adapted across executive, manager, and practitioner depths.
Scene/backdrop: A warm-paper acoustic landscape with a low slate platform.
Subject: One small orange core sphere at the mouth of three nested navy-and-cyan horn-like chambers, sending three distinct smooth ribbons toward simple stone listening bowls placed at increasing distances.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; one dominant crop-safe left-to-right nested-signal silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: clear, aligned, far-reaching; calm directional illumination
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: use only plain sculptural forms and continuous ribbons with no waveform ticks or glyphs; no people and no electronic devices; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
